strategy.name: qqq_dual_raw_stochrsi_cross_first_entry_aligned_broad_robust_2000_2015
strategy.description: Use only 2000–2015 to scan every integer short period from 14 through 50 and long period from 70 through 160 under the fixed raw dual-StochRSI 0.20/0.80 CROSS rule. In every restart window the strategy begins flat. Its candidate-specific Buy & Hold comparator also remains in cash until that candidate's first actual buy fill, then buys once at the identical cost-inclusive fill price and holds through the window end. If no buy occurs, both remain in cash.
strategy.buy_rule: While flat, both completed prior StochRSI values are below 0.20 and both provisional same-session values cross to or above 0.20; buy at the larger joint solved trigger.
strategy.sell_rule: While long, both completed prior StochRSI values are above 0.80 and both provisional same-session values cross to or below 0.80; sell at the smaller joint solved trigger.
strategy.signal_time: Eligibility and exact trigger prices use completed prior data only; every selection window ends no later than 2015-12-31.
strategy.execution_time: Gaps beyond the trigger fill at Open; otherwise only the directed Open-to-Close path may fill at the exact trigger. High and Low are ignored.
strategy.positioning: Every window is a separate long-only 0%/100% QQQ account with 100000 dollars, fractional shares, no leverage, and no cash interest. Strategy and aligned benchmark both wait in cash until the strategy's first fill.

plain_language.summary: 只用2000至2015的大范围参数，寻找既有收益又经得起换起点检验的双周期。
plain_language.buy: 两个周期先同时处于低位，随后一起向上越过0.20时买入QQQ。
plain_language.sell: 两个周期先同时处于高位，随后一起向下跌破0.80时卖出QQQ。
plain_language.execution: 前一日收盘后冻结触发价；跳空越线按开盘价成交，否则只按开盘到收盘方向检查精确触发价。
plain_language.position: 策略和对照都先持有现金；策略第一次实际买入时，对照用相同资金和相同含成本成交价一次买入并持有。

benchmark: Candidate- and window-specific first-entry-aligned Buy & Hold QQQ: cash until the strategy's first actual buy fill, then all-in at that same cost-inclusive fill price and hold; no signal means cash throughout

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse v5 unchanged with a broad robustness surface and first-entry-aligned comparison tables.

research.hypothesis: A broad 14–50 by 70–160 integer grid contains an interior pair that combines strong CAGR with cross-window, chronological, leave-year-out, local-neighborhood, and first-entry-aligned benchmark stability in 2000–2015.
research.primary_metric: Pass all seven frozen robustness gates, then maximize the minimum of the four stability scores; break ties by lower-quartile CAGR, median CAGR, aligned benchmark win rates, and case ID.
research.selection_rule: Screen all 3367 pairs at 5 bps on 132 quarterly left-aligned 3/5/7-year windows ending by 2015. Exclude incomplete boundary neighborhoods and require all seven frozen gates. Among passers rank by maximin, q25 CAGR, median CAGR, Sharpe win rate, CAGR win rate, then case ID. If none passes, report no champion and rank diagnostic near-misses first by gate count, then the same ordering.
research.validation_plan: Reconcile the selected champion or strongest near-miss plus 22/88, 28/88, and 42/100 over all 132 windows at 0/5/10 bps. Selection and replacement cannot inspect data after 2015.
research.promotion_criteria: Only an interior pair passing all seven gates may be called the 2000–2015 robust champion; the result remains exploratory until tested on separately frozen later data.
research.rejection_conditions: Do not name a champion for a boundary pair, any failed gate, ledger mismatch, cost fragility, or use of post-2015 data. Do not compare against a benchmark entered at the window start.
research.leakage_guard: No dates after 2015-12-31 are loaded into the selection windows or used in candidate ranking.
